works.title: Hector Rentier: Political Cartoonist
works.description: A fictional satirist cartoonist character being developed to create visual and textual satire targeting right-wing propaganda, corruption, and institutional hypocrisy. The character is establishing a distinctive voice with literary references (Thomas Nast, Hunter S. Thompson), quote styles, physical presence, and a recurring gopher mascot.
works.quote: Hector Rentier is stronger than the earlier options because the verb is built into the job description: he hectors rentiers.

works.title: Distributional National Accounts (DINA) Comprehensive Methodology Reference
works.description: A comprehensive reference report documenting Distributional National Accounts (DINA) methodology, covering the Piketty-Saez-Zucman approach from the World Inequality Lab and the Auten-Splinter alternative methodology, with detailed analysis of major papers and methodological revisions from 2016 to present.
works.quote: Produce a comprehensive reference report on Distributional National Accounts (DINA) methodology covering: (1) the Piketty-Saez-Zucman methodology as published by the World Inequality Lab, including all major papers, data releases, and methodological revisions from 2016 to present
